en.label: PROFESSIONAL RÉSUMÉ
en.headline: Electronic Engineer | Junior Data Analyst | Financial and Operational Data
en.summary: Electronic Engineer from Universidad de los Andes with experience in High Risk account operations at Iron Mountain. I review account, service, invoice, and payment records; investigate billing discrepancies; and prepare reports, charts, and workflow tools for operational follow-up. I contributed to loading approximately 18,000 accounts into Oracle and automated abandoned-record processing. Seeking junior Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Business Analyst, or Operations Analyst roles.

experience.title: Strategic Planning & High-Risk Account Specialist
bullets: Contributed to the bulk load of approximately 18,000 accounts into Oracle, replacing record-by-record manual entry.
Automated abandoned-record processing with a web tool and built a dashboard to track account loading and recovery.
Compare account, invoice, payment, inventory, and service records in Excel to find and investigate billing discrepancies.
Review and prioritize High Risk account cases, track their status, and coordinate operational follow-up.
Explain outstanding balances and payment requirements on inactive accounts so authorized teams can decide on service restoration.

experience.title: IT Support Assistant
bullets: Performed software quality testing and managed electronics inventory.
Conducted preliminary exploration of business opportunities related to sensors.

experience.title: Customer Service Agent
bullets: Handled customer service requests in an English-language support environment and followed service workflows.

education.title: Electronic Engineering
education.detail: Thesis: IoT automation of electronic systems integrating an adjustable voltage source and an AD9833 signal generator. Work involved system integration, measurement, and technical testing.

projects.title: Bogotá 2025 public-budget commitments
projects.description: Analyzed 7,681 official detail records covering 50 entity labels and 2,198 budget-item codes. Python cleaning and validation, plus SQL JOINs, CTEs, and window functions, reconcile monthly changes to COP 36.26 trillion in cumulative December commitments. Retained 752 records with cumulative decreases for review.

projects.title: NovaTech: invoices, payments, and monthly performance
projects.description: Built a 4,800-row generated invoice-and-payment dataset (Canada/CAD and United States/USD, 2024–2025) and a monthly dashboard of invoiced, paid, recovered, and outstanding amounts. Python and SQL checks verify record IDs, payment status, and invoice = paid + outstanding. The CSV can be edited in Excel and reloaded into the dashboard.
projects.tools: Python · SQL · SQLite · Excel · CSV · React · TypeScript

projects.title: Operations Data Review Suite
projects.description: Built a browser-based tool with six workflows for filtering sample records, reference matching, CSV import/export, record updates, follow-up notes, and knowledge articles. The demo uses generated data and browser storage only.

projects.title: Operations Decision Copilot
projects.description: Built a browser-based rule-driven prototype that structures a fictional operations case into confirmed facts, open questions, and verification steps for human review. It prepares a review note; it does not use AI or make account decisions.

Automaticé el procesamiento de registros abandonados con una herramienta web y creé un dashboard para seguir la carga y recuperación de cuentas.
Comparo en Excel registros de cuentas, facturas, pagos, inventario y servicio para detectar e investigar diferencias de facturación.
Reviso y priorizo casos de cuentas High Risk, hago seguimiento a su estado y coordino acciones operativas.
Explico saldos pendientes y pagos requeridos en cuentas inactivas para que los equipos autorizados decidan sobre la restauración del servicio.
